'''''Bad Pet''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]]<ref name="CGP" /> created after [[104 ABY]]<ref name="Date" /> depicting a rampage by four [[Rancor/Legends|rancors]] inside an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] containing [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttles]] and a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]]. The most prominent rancor in the image stood in front of a ruined [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighter]] while holding another [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] above their head, with one of the fighter's wings missing and the other crushed to pieces.<ref name="CGP" />

In the background, one rancor pursued a pair of fleeing [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] near the wreckage of another TIE/LN starfighter, while two other rancors tore a Lambda [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] apart. In the painting's foreground, the<ref name="CGP" /> [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]]<ref name="Dark Side">''[[The Dark Side Sourcebook]]''</ref> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] pointed up towards the prominent rancor while facing a crowd of stormtroopers and an [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]].<ref name="CGP" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Bad Pet'' appeared in "[[Celestia Galactica Photografica]]," a collection of [[in-universe]] illustrations by [[Ryan Church]] included in ''[[Star Wars: Visionaries]]'', a [[2005]] graphic novel edited by [[Jeremy Barlow]].<ref name="CGP" />
